accumulation_window_clarification: Projection is performed after every optimizer accumulation window. In each epoch, 20 windows contain 32 microbatches and the final fixed partial window contains 24 microbatches; the inherited loss scale remains 1/32 for that partial window.
statistical_status: Preregistered internal development-set confirmation, not an independent sealed confirmation.
bootstrap_estimand: Item-weighted mean absolute-error difference with question-cluster resampling, conditional on the five trained seeds.
analysis_registration_boundary: The primary comparison, effect thresholds, non-inferiority thresholds, seeds and cluster-CI decision rule were frozen before results. The exact analysis implementation, 10000 repetitions and RNG seed 57 were implemented after results and must not be described as fully preregistered code.
mechanism_claim: A stable non-collinear raw-gradient contribution under the frozen standard-clipping and AdamW setting.
prohibited_claims: exclusion of all clipping or AdamW interactions
next_confirmatory_design: External multi-rater ordinal data with Reference-only, Aligned Orthogonal-only and fixed Shuffled Orthogonal-only over three frozen seeds.
